author: Cinna Davis (OpenAI Codex assisted)
statement: For arbitrary explicit affine binary systems A m=b on cyclic adjacent products m_i=x_i x_(i+1), a deterministic polynomial-space exact count takes poly(n+a) 2^(d-r) lambda^r bit operations, where d is nullity, r is the maximum length of a cyclic interval of independent kernel coordinate functionals, and lambda=1.754877666.... A consistent family has d=n/2 and r=2. No general SAT improvement is claimed. A greedily found packing of t jointly independent consecutive triples gives poly(n+a) 2^(d-3t) 7^t time; an explicit fragmented family makes this candidate bound exponentially smaller than a single-block bound. Its decision problem is NP-complete even with matrix row weight at most two, via a non-parsimonious 3-SAT reduction.
remaining_obligations: Independent review of all-size proof and costs
Establish any needed r bound for actual all-input outer queries
Account for reductions, all candidate queries and decoding before any SAT claim
